label: fd-failures/main
sql:
SELECT
  coalesce(nullIf(SpanAttributes['exception.type'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['error.type'], ''), 'Unclassified error') AS category,
  SpanName AS operation,
  min(StartTime) AS first_seen,
  count() AS failures
FROM spans
WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND StatusCode = 2)
GROUP BY category, operation
ORDER BY failures DESC
LIMIT 7

label: ck-kpis/outcomes
sql:
SELECT
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed,
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved,
  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed_prev,
  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved_prev
FROM (SELECT trace_id,
    any(at) AS at, argMax(outcome, sent) AS outcome, argMax(reason, sent) AS reason
  FROM (
    SELECT trace_id, at, label AS outcome, label AS reason, 0 AS sent
    FROM (SELECT
    e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS at, e.EvaluatorName AS evaluator, e.Label AS label,
    e.Passed = 1 AS ok, e.Passed IS NOT NULL AND NOT e.IsGuardrail
      AND e.EvaluatorName != 'Conversation Outcome Judge' AS is_check,
    t.customer AS customer
  FROM evaluation_metrics AS e
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt, ifNull(CustomerId, '') AS customer
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  ) AS t ON t.TraceId = e.TraceId
  WHERE e.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( e.OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))))
    WHERE evaluator = 'Conversation Outcome Judge'
      AND label != ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS at, Attributes['metadata.outcome'] AS outcome,
      coalesce(nullIf(Attributes['metadata.outcome_reason'], ''), Attributes['metadata.outcome']) AS reason,
      1 AS sent
    FROM traces
    WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND Attributes['metadata.outcome'] != '')

  GROUP BY trace_id)

label: ck-trend/changes
sql:
SELECT kind, name, addSeconds(toStartOfInterval(subtractSeconds(first_at, 345600), INTERVAL {dashboard_context_granularity_seconds:UInt32} SECOND), 345600) AS bucket
FROM (
  SELECT 'model' AS kind, arrayJoin(Models) AS name, min(OccurredAt) AS first_at
  FROM trace_metrics
  WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 90) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  GROUP BY name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'prompt' AS kind,
    coalesce(nullIf(LastUsedPromptVersionId, ''), nullIf(Attributes['metadata.prompt_version'], '')) AS name,
    min(OccurredAt) AS first_at
  FROM traces
  WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= least(subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1), subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 90)))) AND (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= least(subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1), subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 90))) AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 90) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND name IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY name
)
WHERE first_at > (SELECT min(OccurredAt) + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM trace_metrics WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 90) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))
  AND first_at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
ORDER BY first_at
LIMIT 8

sql:
SELECT
  sum(cost) AS spend,
  countIf(failed) AS failed_traces,
  sumIf(cost, failed) AS failed_cost,
  countIf(NOT failed AND repeats > 0) AS loop_traces,
  sumIf(cost * repeats / greatest(spans, 1), NOT failed AND repeats > 0) AS loop_cost,
  countIf(NOT failed AND repeats = 0 AND retries > 0) AS retry_traces,
  sumIf(retries * llm_cost / greatest(llm_ok, 1), NOT failed AND repeats = 0 AND retries > 0)
    AS retry_cost
FROM (SELECT ifNull(s.failed, 0) = 1 AS failed, t.cost AS cost,
    ifNull(s.spans, 0) AS spans, ifNull(s.retries, 0) AS retries,
    ifNull(s.repeats, 0) AS repeats, ifNull(s.llm_cost, 0) AS llm_cost, ifNull(s.llm_ok, 0) AS llm_ok
  FROM (
    SELECT TraceId, TotalCost AS cost
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  ) AS t
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, max(root_failed) AS failed, sum(calls) AS spans, sum(errored_llm) AS retries,
      sumIf(calls - 1, is_tool AND calls >= 3) AS repeats,
      sum(ok_llm_cost) AS llm_cost, sum(ok_llm) AS llm_ok
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, SpanName,
        SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'tool' AS is_tool,
        count() AS calls,
        max(ifNull(ParentSpanId, '') = '' AND StatusCode = 2) AS root_failed,
        countIf(StatusCode = 2 AND SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'llm') AS errored_llm,
        countIf(StatusCode != 2 AND SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'llm') AS ok_llm,
        sumIf(ifNull(Cost, 0), StatusCode != 2 AND SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'llm')
          AS ok_llm_cost
      FROM spans
      WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
      GROUP BY TraceId, SpanName, is_tool
    )
    GROUP BY TraceId
  ) AS s ON s.TraceId = t.TraceId)

  quantileExactIf(0.95)(listening_ms, started >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}, intDiv(dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}), 2))) AS listening_second_p95,
  quantileExact(0.95)(thinking_ms) AS thinking_p95,

sql:
SELECT step,

  countIf(recovered) AS recovered
FROM (
  SELECT c.SpanName AS step,
    c.StatusCode = 2 AS failed,
    c.StatusCode = 2 AND p.StatusCode != 2 AS recovered
  FROM spans AS c
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, SpanId, StatusCode
    FROM spans
    WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 1) AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  ) AS p ON p.TraceId = c.TraceId AND p.SpanId = c.ParentSpanId
  WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (c.TenantId, c.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (c.TenantId, c.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( c.StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND c.StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND c.ParentSpanId IS NOT NULL
    AND c.SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'tool')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.SpanName AS step, r.StatusCode = 2 AS failed, false AS recovered
  FROM spans AS r
  LEFT ANTI JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT TraceId, ParentSpanId
    FROM spans
    WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
